data.summary: The property manager Hausverwaltung Muster & Partner wrote on 22 December 2025 about heat cost allocator readings and smoke alarm servicing in January 2026. You must tell them within 7 working days of the letter date which proposed appointment suits you.
data.explanation: The owners' association will have the heat cost allocators (Heizkostenverteiler) read and the smoke alarms serviced in your flat. Three dates are proposed: 12, 14 or 16 January 2026, between 8:00 and 12:00. Reply to the property manager within 7 working days (Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays) of the letter date, saying which date you can give access. The app shows the deadline. The letter does not state what happens if you don't reply, but you risk losing the choice of date.
